usedFor: Shopify takes the orders, and cloudsmith controls repository access through “Disable Entitlement Token”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Disable Entitlement Token” in cloudsmith
bestTemplate.why: A cancelled order revokes the buyer's repository access by disabling their token.

watchOut: “Disable Entitlement Token” revokes access, so make sure the trigger is a real cancellation.
